source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by plain white)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, units px

camera.motion: assumed static (simulation clips use a fixed camera). Background is uniform white, so camera motion cannot be checked directly; all three objects move in different directions, consistent with a fixed camera.
camera.perspective_cues: No ground, water, horizon or vanishing lines visible (background removed). Depth cues only from apparent object size: boat slowly shrinks (receding), human about constant (~70-77 px tall), bird wingspan peaks about constant (~66-70 px).
camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from given depth_info + known size (f_px = pixel_size * depth / world_size)

objects.name: boat
objects.description: Large red-and-white fishing boat (red hull, white cabin with red roof, tall mast with crossbar, dark crane/davit arm at the right of the cabin) in the lower-left of the frame
objects.motion: drifts left and slightly up in the image at ~4 px/frame left, ~1.6 px/frame up; apparent size shrinks slightly (bbox height 453 px at f0 -> ~430 px at f50) -> moving away from camera while moving left

size_px_frame0.note: bbox from mast top (y=469) to keel bottom (y=921), stern-left edge x=188 to bow tip x=462; boat is seen 3/4 from the front-right, so bbox_w mixes length and beam

objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y (bbox centre while unclipped; bow-based extrapolation once clipped, ~3 px mean / 9 px max error on test). Blender origin of the boat is not visible; the hull centre is lower than the bbox centre (bbox includes the mast).

objects.name: human
objects.description: Small walking man (white T-shirt, dark trousers, pale skin) right of centre, around x=660-760, y=565-680
objects.motion: walks steadily left and slightly toward the camera: centroid x 755 -> 665 px, y 602 -> 642 px over 3 s; bbox height about constant 67-78 px (gait oscillation)
objects.reference_point: mask centroid cx, cy (approximate pelvis; pelvis is about at the mask centroid / slightly below mid-height of bbox)

objects.name: bird
objects.description: Dark (black-brown) flying bird, flapping, above the boat/human
objects.motion: flies right and slightly down: centroid (318,327) at f0 -> (924,531) at f53, ~11-14 px/frame; leaves through the right image edge f54-f58; not visible from f59

events.event: all three objects already moving at first frame
bird first touches right image edge
boat stern first touches left image edge (clipped thereafter)
last frame the bird is visible (sliver at right edge)
bird wings at flat/extended pose (bbox height minimum, wingspan near maximum) - flap cycle ~12 frames (~0.48 s)
bird wings raised/folded pose (bbox height maximum, width minimum)
